A systematic meta-analysis of genetic, regional, and production determinants of global pork quality

Code and model outputs - pH 24h

1 Loading packages and data

## load the packages
library(metafor)
library(orchaRd)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(openxlsx)
library(MuMIn)
library(glue)
library(rlang)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
## Load the functions from the script file
source("functions.R")
## Load the data for pH 24h
data_PH24 <- read.csv("PH24.csv")

## Convert columns to appropriate numeric types
data_PH24$Mean <- as.numeric(data_PH24$Mean)
data_PH24$SD <- as.numeric(data_PH24$SD)
data_PH24$Sample <- as.numeric(data_PH24$Sample)
data_PH24$Age <- as.numeric(data_PH24$Age)
data_PH24$Weight <- as.numeric(data_PH24$Weight)
data_PH24$Digestible_energy <- as.numeric(data_PH24$Digestible_energy)
data_PH24$Crude_protein <- as.numeric(data_PH24$Crude_protein)
data_PH24$Crude_fat <- as.numeric(data_PH24$Crude_fat)
data_PH24$Crude_fiber <- as.numeric(data_PH24$Crude_fiber)
data_PH24$Ash <- as.numeric(data_PH24$Ash)
data_PH24$Lys <- as.numeric(data_PH24$Lys)
data_PH24$Met_and_Cys <- as.numeric(data_PH24$Met_and_Cys)
data_PH24$Thr <- as.numeric(data_PH24$Thr)
data_PH24$Try <- as.numeric(data_PH24$Try)
data_PH24$Val <- as.numeric(data_PH24$Val)
data_PH24$Dry_matter <- as.numeric(data_PH24$Dry_matter)
data_PH24$Ca <- as.numeric(data_PH24$Ca)
data_PH24$P <- as.numeric(data_PH24$P)
data_PH24$Na <- as.numeric(data_PH24$Na)

## Convert columns to factor types
data_PH24$Position <- factor(data_PH24$Position)
data_PH24$Breed <- factor(data_PH24$Breed)
data_PH24$Class <- factor(data_PH24$Class)
data_PH24$Sex <- factor(data_PH24$Sex)
data_PH24$Region <- factor(data_PH24$Region) 
data_PH24$Aim <- factor(data_PH24$Aim)
data_PH24$Multiple_breeds <- factor(data_PH24$Multiple_breeds)

## Calculate variance (rVar)
# rVar is the square of the standard error (SD/sqrt(Sample))
data_PH24$rVar <- (data_PH24$SD/sqrt(data_PH24$Sample))^2

2 Testing random effects

## Run VCV matrix for all data
VCV_PH24_AllData <- make_VCV_matrix(data_PH24, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")

## Null model with VCV matrix:
# This model includes random effects for RowID (observation-level) and StudyID.
null_PH24_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_PH24_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_PH24, method = "ML")
summary(null_PH24_mod) #-559.4330            
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 1135; method: ML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
##  282.7165  4933.9492  -559.4330  -544.3298  -559.4117   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0164  0.1280   1135     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  0.0259  0.1609    540     no  StudyID 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 1134) = 988781.3710, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se      zval    pval   ci.lb   ci.ub      
##   5.6387  0.0086  655.5515  <.0001  5.6218  5.6555  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## Test whether Region should be a random effect:
# Adds Region as a random effect to the null model structure.
Re_PH24_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_PH24_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID,
                                     ~1 |Region), 
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_PH24, method = "ML")
summary(Re_PH24_mod) #-559.1308             
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 1135; method: ML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc

## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor

## sigma^2.2  0.0246  0.1570    540     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  0.0013  0.0356     62     no   Region 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 1134) = 988781.3710, p-val < .0001
##

## Test whether Position should be a random effect:

Po_PH24_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_PH24_AllData,

                     sparse = TRUE,

## Full model with fixed effects for Position, Breed, Region, and Class
PH24_full_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_PH24_AllData, 
                      mods = ~Position + Breed + Region + Class, 
                      random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID),
                      sparse = TRUE,
                      data = data_PH24, method = "ML")
R2_Full <- round(r2_ml(PH24_full_mod)*100, 2)
anova(PH24_full_mod,null_PH24_mod)
## 
##          df       AIC       BIC      AICc   logLik      LRT   pval          QE 
## Full    309 -741.5666  814.0593 -509.3484 679.7833                  38268.1190 
## Reduced   3 -559.4330 -544.3298 -559.4117 282.7165 794.1336 <.0001 988781.3710
## Model with Position as a fixed effect
PH24_Position_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_PH24_AllData, 
                           mods = ~Position,
                           random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                         ~1 |StudyID),
                           sparse = TRUE,
                           data = data_PH24, method = "ML")
R2_Position <-round(r2_ml(PH24_Position_mod)*100, 2)
anova(PH24_Position_mod,null_PH24_mod)
## 
##         df       AIC       BIC      AICc   logLik      LRT   pval          QE 
## Full    25 -621.6825 -495.8228 -620.5103 335.8413                 979028.5988 
## Reduced  3 -559.4330 -544.3298 -559.4117 282.7165 106.2495 <.0001 988781.3710
## Model with Breed as a fixed effect
PH24_Breed_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_PH24_AllData, 
                            mods = ~Breed,
                            random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                          ~1 |StudyID),
                            sparse = TRUE,
                            data = data_PH24, method = "ML")
R2_Breed <- round(r2_ml(PH24_Breed_mod)*100, 2)
anova(PH24_Breed_mod,null_PH24_mod)
## 
##          df       AIC       BIC      AICc   logLik      LRT   pval          QE

## Reduced   3 -559.4330 -544.3298 -559.4117 282.7165 474.6475 <.0001 988781.3710
## Model with Region as a fixed effect
PH24_Region_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_PH24_AllData, 
                           mods = ~Region, 
                           random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                         ~1 |StudyID),
                           sparse = TRUE,

R2_Region <- round(r2_ml(PH24_Region_mod)*100, 2) 
anova(PH24_Region_mod,null_PH24_mod)

## Model with Class as a fixed effect
PH24_Class_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_PH24_AllData, 
                           mods = ~Class,
                           random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                         ~1 |StudyID),
                           sparse = TRUE,

R2_Class <- round(r2_ml(PH24_Class_mod)*100, 2)
anova(PH24_Class_mod,null_PH24_mod)
##

## Full    22 -601.0526 -490.2961 -600.1425 322.5263                837487.3139 
## Reduced  3 -559.4330 -544.3298 -559.4117 282.7165 79.6196 <.0001 988781.3710
## Create a table of R-squared values for models with moderators
R2_models_summary <- data.frame("Model" = c("Full",
                                     "Position",
                                     "Breed",
                                     "Region", 
                                     "Class"),
                        "R2" = c(R2_Full[1],
                                 R2_Position[1],
                                 R2_Breed[1],
                                 R2_Region[1], 
                                 R2_Class[1]))
R2_models_summary <- R2_models_summary %>% 
  transmute(Model = Model
            ,R2= round(R2,2))

colnames(R2_models_summary)[2] <- "$R^2(\\%)$"

R2_models_summary %>% 
  kable(format="html", escape=F, caption="Heterogeneity explained in the models with moderators") %>% 
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>% 
  kable_styling(c("hover", "condensed"), full_width = F)

## Refit with REML for reporting in Manuscript does not.
REML_PH24_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_PH24_AllData, 
                        random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                      ~1 |StudyID,
                                      ~1 |Breed,
                                      # ~1 | Region, # Region was not better than null in initial test
                                      ~1 |Position),
                        sparse = TRUE,
                        data = data_PH24, method = "REML")
summary(REML_PH24_mod)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 1135; method: REML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
##  366.4483  -732.8967  -722.8967  -697.7291  -722.8435   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0099  0.0994   1135     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  0.0244  0.1562    540     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  0.0083  0.0913    228     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.4  0.0231  0.1520     23     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 1134) = 988781.3710, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se      zval    pval   ci.lb   ci.ub      
##   5.7728  0.0395  146.0835  <.0001  5.6954  5.8503  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
# Calculate I-squared values
round(i2_ml(REML_PH24_mod), 2)
##    I2_Total    I2_RowID  I2_StudyID    I2_Breed I2_Position 
##       99.73       14.98       37.03       12.65       35.06
# Calculate R-squared
round(r2_ml(REML_PH24_mod)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.00          84.98
## Generate orchard plot for the REML model
p_REML_PH24 <- orchard_plot(REML_PH24_mod,
                               group = "StudyID",  
                               xlab = "Mean pH 24h", 
                               cb = FALSE,
                               angle = 0,
                               legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                               branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_REML_PH24)

3 Meta-regression

3.1 Breed

## Filter data for breeds with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_PH24_B3 <- data_PH24 %>%
  group_by(Breed) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(StudyID) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

## Create VCV matrix for the filtered breed data
VCV_PH24_B3_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_PH24_B3, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")
## Define random structure
random_structure_breed <- list(~1 |RowID,
                               ~1 |StudyID,
                               ~1 |Position) 

# Model with intercept
Br_VCV_REML_PH24_mod_int <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_PH24_B3_Data,
  mods = ~ Breed,
  random = random_structure_breed,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_PH24_B3)
summary(Br_VCV_REML_PH24_mod_int)

3.6 Age

## Filter data for complete cases of Age
data_PH24_Age <- data_PH24[complete.cases(data_PH24$Age), ]

## Create VCV matrix for Age data
VCV_PH24_Age_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_PH24_Age, 
                                    V = "rVar", 
                                    cluster = "StudyID", 
                                    obs = "RowID")
## Define common random structure for continuous moderators
random_structure_continuous <- list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID,
                                    ~1 |Breed, 
                                    ~1 |Position)

## Run meta-regression for Age
res_PH24_Age <- run_meta_ct(
  dat         = data_PH24_Age,          
  mod_var     = "Age",
  random_list = random_structure_continuous, 
  plot_name   = "p_PH24_Age",              
  x_lab       = "Age (Days)",
  y_lab       = "Mean pH 24h" 
)

## Generate summary table for Age models
mods_list_age <- attr(res_PH24_Age$best_model, "mods_list") 
aic_tab_age   <- res_PH24_Age$aic_table                   

tbl_PH24_Age <- model_summary_tbl(
  mods_list_age, aic_tab_age, 
  lin_coef  = "mod_c",              
  quad_coef = "mod_c2"
)
## Display summary table for Age models

3.13 Dry matter

## Filter data for complete cases of Dry_matter
data_PH24_DM <- data_PH24[complete.cases(data_PH24$Dry_matter), ]
 
## Create VCV matrix for Dry matter data
VCV_PH24_DM_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_PH24_DM, 
                                    V = "rVar", 
                                    cluster = "StudyID", 
                                    obs = "RowID")
# 1. Data Preparation
data_PH24_DM <- data_PH24_DM %>%
  filter(!is.na(Dry_matter), !is.na(Mean), !is.na(rVar)) %>%
  mutate(
    mu     = mean(Dry_matter, na.rm = TRUE),
    DM_c   = Dry_matter - mu,
    DM_c2  = DM_c^2,
    Prec   = 1 / sqrt(rVar)
  )

VCV_PH24_DM_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(
  data_PH24_DM,
  V       = "rVar",
  cluster = "StudyID",
  obs     = "RowID"
)

# 2. Model Fitting & Selection
rand_layers <- list(~1|RowID, ~1|StudyID, ~1|Breed, ~1|Position)
ctrl <- list(optimizer="optim", optmethod="BFGS", maxiter=2000, reltol=1e-8)

fit0 <- rma.mv(Mean, VCV_PH24_DM_Data, mods = ~1,
               random = rand_layers, data = data_PH24_DM,
               method="ML", test="t", control=ctrl)
fit1 <- rma.mv(Mean, VCV_PH24_DM_Data, mods = ~DM_c,
               random = rand_layers, data = data_PH24_DM,
               method="ML", test="t", control=ctrl)
fit2 <- rma.mv(Mean, VCV_PH24_DM_Data, mods = ~DM_c + DM_c2,
               random = rand_layers, data = data_PH24_DM,
               method="ML", test="t", control=ctrl)

ms_tab <- model.sel(list(fit0=fit0, fit1=fit1, fit2=fit2), rank="AICc")
print(ms_tab, digits=3)
## Model selection table 
##      (Int)     mods df logLik AICc delta weight
## fit0     +           5  5.006  1.3  0.00  0.555
## fit1     +      D_c  6  5.585  2.7  1.42  0.273
## fit2     + D_c+D_c2  7  6.470  3.7  2.34  0.172
## Abbreviations:
##  mods:  = '~1', D_c = '~DM_c', D_c+D_c2 = '~DM_c+DM_c2'
## Models ranked by AICc(x)
anova(fit0, fit1)
## 
##         df     AIC     BIC   AICc logLik    LRT   pval          QE 
## Full     6  0.8307 12.4217 2.7398 5.5847               906017.8034 
## Reduced  5 -0.0113  9.6478 1.3220 5.0056 1.1580 0.2819 906023.0467
anova(fit1, fit2)
## 
##         df    AIC     BIC   AICc logLik    LRT   pval          QE 
## Full     7 1.0594 14.5821 3.6640 6.4703               905638.7603 
## Reduced  6 0.8307 12.4217 2.7398 5.5847 1.7713 0.1832 906017.8034
best_key <- rownames(ms_tab)[1]   # “fit0” / “fit1” / “fit2”
best_mod <- switch(best_key,
                   fit0 = update(fit0, method="REML"),
                   fit1 = update(fit1, method="REML"),
                   fit2 = update(fit2, method="REML"))

# 3. Plotting Functions
plot_linear <- function(model, df) {
  mu   <- mean(df$Dry_matter, na.rm=TRUE)
  newdat <- data.frame(
    Dry_matter = seq(min(df$Dry_matter), max(df$Dry_matter), length.out=200)
  ) %>% mutate(
    DM_c = Dry_matter - mu
  )
  ci   <- predict(model, newmods=newdat$DM_c)
  newdat <- newdat %>% mutate(
    fit    = ci$pred,
    ci_lwr = ci$ci.lb,
    ci_upr = ci$ci.ub
  )
  beta1 <- coef(model)["DM_c"]
  p_val <- summary(model)$pval["DM_c"]
  R2m   <- r2_ml(model)["R2_marginal"]*100
  
  ggplot(df, aes(Dry_matter, Mean)) +
    geom_point(aes(size=Prec), shape=21, fill="grey65",
               colour="black", stroke=.25, alpha=.6) +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(.5,4), name="Precision\n(1/SE)") +
    geom_ribbon(data=newdat,
                aes(x=Dry_matter, ymin=ci_lwr, ymax=ci_upr),
                fill="grey85", alpha=.5, inherit.aes=FALSE) +
    geom_line(data=newdat,
              aes(x=Dry_matter, y=fit),
              colour="firebrick", linewidth=.9) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Na)+.03*diff(range(df$Na)),
             y=min(df$Mean)+.07*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("β = %.3f\nR² = %.2f%%\nP = %.3g",
                           beta1, R2m, p_val),
             colour="blue4", hjust=0, size=3.2) +
    labs(x="Na (% DM)", y="Aspartic acid (%)") +
    theme_classic(base_size=11) +
    theme(panel.border=element_rect(colour="black", fill=NA),
          legend.position=c(.98,.99),
          legend.justification=c(1,1))
}

plot_quadratic <- function(model, df) {
  mu   <- mean(df$Dry_matter, na.rm=TRUE)
  newdat <- data.frame(
    Dry_matter = seq(min(df$Dry_matter), max(df$Dry_matter), length.out=200)
  ) %>% mutate(
    DM_c  = Dry_matter - mu,
    DM_c2 = DM_c^2
  )
  ci   <- predict(model, newmods=as.matrix(newdat[,c("DM_c","DM_c2")]))
  newdat <- newdat %>% mutate(
    fit    = ci$pred,
    ci_lwr = ci$ci.lb,
    ci_upr = ci$ci.ub
  )
  b1    <- coef(model)["DM_c"]
  b2    <- coef(model)["DM_c2"]
  x_opt <- -b1/(2*b2) + mu
  p_val <- summary(model)$pval["DM_c2"]
  R2m   <- r2_ml(model)["R2_marginal"]*100
  
  ggplot(df, aes(Dry_matter, Mean)) +
    geom_point(aes(size=Prec), shape=21, fill="grey65",
               colour="black", stroke=.25, alpha=.6) +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(.5,4), name="Precision\n(1/SE)") +
    geom_ribbon(data=newdat,
                aes(x=Dry_matter, ymin=ci_lwr, ymax=ci_upr),
                fill="grey85", alpha=.5) +
    geom_line(data=newdat,
              aes(x=Dry_matter, y=fit),
              colour="firebrick", linewidth=.9) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=x_opt,
               linetype="dNaed", colour="red3",
               linewidth=.8) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Dry_matter)+.02*diff(range(df$Dry_matter)),
             y=max(df$Mean)-.03*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("Dry_matter = %.1f%%", x_opt),
             hjust=0, vjust=1, size=3.2) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Dry_matter)+.03*diff(range(df$Dry_matter)),
             y=min(df$Mean)+.07*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("R² = %.2f%%\nP = %.3g", R2m, p_val),
             colour="blue4", hjust=0, size=3.2) +
    labs(x="Dry_matter (% DM)", y="Aspartic acid (%)") +
    theme_classic(base_size=11) +
    theme(panel.border=element_rect(colour="black", fill=NA),
          axis.ticks.length=unit(0.15,"cm"),
          legend.position=c(.98,.99),
          legend.justification=c(1,1)) +
    coord_cartesian(expand=FALSE)
}

# 4. Plotting based on best model
if (best_key == "fit1") {
  print(plot_linear(best_mod, data_PH24_DM))
} else if (best_key == "fit2") {
  print(plot_quadratic(best_mod, data_PH24_DM))
} else {
  message("No significant effect of Na")
}

mods <- list(
  Linear    = fit1,
  Quadratic = fit2,
  Null      = fit0
)

aic_tab <- ms_tab                          

map_names <- c(fit0 = "Null", fit1 = "Linear", fit2 = "Quadratic")
rownames(aic_tab) <- map_names[rownames(aic_tab)]

best_row   <- rownames(aic_tab)[1]
best_label <- c(Null="Null", Linear="Linear", Quadratic="Quadratic")[best_row]


tbl_PH24_DM <- bind_rows(lapply(names(mods), function(label){
  m <- mods[[label]]
  R2m <- r2_ml(m)["R2_marginal"] * 100
  
  if (label == "Linear") {               
    p_val <- summary(m)$pval[2]              
  } else if (label == "Quadratic") {      
    p_val <- summary(m)$pval[3]             
  } else {                                
    p_val <- NA
  }
  
  AICc  <- aic_tab[label, "AICc"]
  delta <- aic_tab[label, "delta"]
  
  data.frame(
    Model         = label,
    Adjusted_R2   = round(R2m, 2),
    P_value       = signif(p_val, 3),
    AICc          = round(AICc, 2),
    Delta_AICc    = round(delta, 2),
    Selected_Model= ifelse(label == best_label, "✔", "")
  )
}))


print(tbl_PH24_DM)
##                     Model Adjusted_R2 P_value AICc Delta_AICc Selected_Model
## R2_marginal...1    Linear        2.52   0.272 2.74       1.42               
## R2_marginal...2 Quadratic        6.03   0.186 3.66       2.34               
## R2_marginal...3      Null        0.00      NA 1.32       0.00              ✔
## Display summary table for Dry Matter models
html_table_dm <- tbl_PH24_DM %>% 
  kable(format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")

VCV_PH24_MC_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_PH24_MC, 
                                    V = "rVar", 
                                    cluster = "StudyID", 
                                    obs = "RowID")
## Run meta-regression for Methionine + Cysteine
res_PH24_MC <- run_meta_ct(
  dat         = data_PH24_MC,          
  mod_var     = "Met_and_Cys",
  random_list = random_structure_continuous, 
  plot_name   = "p_PH24_MC",              
  x_lab       = "Methionine + Cysteine (% of DM)", 
  y_lab       = "Mean pH 24h" 
)

## Generate summary table for Methionine + Cysteine models
mods_list_mc <- attr(res_PH24_MC$best_model, "mods_list") 
aic_tab_mc   <- res_PH24_MC$aic_table                   

tbl_PH24_MC <- model_summary_tbl(
  mods_list_mc, aic_tab_mc, 
  lin_coef  = "mod_c",              
  quad_coef = "mod_c2"
)
## Display summary table for Methionine + Cysteine models
html_table_mc <- tbl_PH24_MC %>% 
  kable(format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")  
print(html_table_mc)

4 Publication bias and sensitivity analyses

4.1 Decline effect (Publication Year)

## Define random structure
random_structure_Ye <- list(~1 |RowID,
                            ~1 |StudyID,
                            ~1 |Breed, 
                            ~1 |Position) 

## Model with Publication Year (Years) as moderator
Ye_VCV_REML_PH24_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_PH24_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Years,
   random = random_structure_Ye, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_PH24)
summary(Ye_VCV_REML_PH24_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 1135; method: REML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
##  366.0983  -732.1966  -720.1966  -690.0008  -720.1220   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0099  0.0994   1135     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  0.0245  0.1565    540     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  0.0083  0.0913    228     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.4  0.0231  0.1521     23     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 1133) = 987714.2264, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 1133) = 0.0014, p-val = 0.9704
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##          estimate      se    tval    df    pval    ci.lb    ci.ub    
## intrcpt    5.5626  5.6610  0.9826  1133  0.3260  -5.5447  16.6699    
## Years      0.0001  0.0028  0.0371  1133  0.9704  -0.0054   0.0056    
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Ye_VCV_REML_PH24_mod_int)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.00          84.99
## Bubble plot for decline effect
p_Ye_VCV_REML_PH24 <- orchaRd::bubble_plot(Ye_VCV_REML_PH24_mod_int, 
                                  mod = "Years",
                                  group = "StudyID",
                                  xlab = "Publication year",
                                  ylab = "Mean pH 24h", 
                                  g = TRUE)
p_Ye_VCV_REML_PH24 <- p_Ye_VCV_REML_PH24 + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2014, 2024, by = 2))
print(p_Ye_VCV_REML_PH24)

4.2 Aim (Whether the aim of study was meat quality)

## Define random structure

#Model with intercept

   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_PH24_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Aim,
   random = random_structure_aim, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_PH24)
summary(Ai_VCV_REML_PH24_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 1135; method: REML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
##  366.0914  -732.1828  -720.1828  -689.9871  -720.1082   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0099  0.0994   1135     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  0.0245  0.1565    540     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  0.0083  0.0913    228     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.4  0.0231  0.1521     23     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 1133) = 987121.2146, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 1133) = 0.0034, p-val = 0.9532
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##          estimate      se      tval    df    pval    ci.lb   ci.ub      
## intrcpt    5.7720  0.0423  136.3413  1133  <.0001   5.6889  5.8550  *** 
## AimYes     0.0012  0.0204    0.0586  1133  0.9532  -0.0388  0.0411      
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1

##           0.00          84.99
#Model without intercept for plotting
Ai_VCV_REML_PH24_mod <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_PH24_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Aim -1,
   random = random_structure_aim,

## Orchard plot for Aim moderator
